**Issue from last week's price increase**

The catalog check reports that 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 to P-1222) had their prices raised 3% on 2026-10-14. These should have been excluded. Eight orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, for a total overcharge of 4,128.60.
